name: mplate-monorepo
description: mplate: engine, CLI, MCP server and studio

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mplate/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.studio:dev: npm run build -w @mplate/core && npm run dev -w @mplate/studio
scripts.studio:build: npm run build -w @mplate/core && npm run build -w @mplate/studio
